evidence_snippets: For a selected indicator, on the IOC details page, you can do the following: View event prioritization View associations Event viewer On the Events tab, on a selected indicator, you can view how an event is prioritized and the details for an event.

View the IOCs View data Filter IOCs View IOC details View IOCs The IOC matches page displays all the IOCs and their details, such as type, priority, status, categories, assets, campaigns, sources, IOC ingest time, first seen, and last seen.
